optimizedDescription.value: Central domain entity for in-progress spec work: lifecycle, approvals, artifacts, append-only history, invalidation.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules
- Immutable `name` + `createdAt`. Actors: `ActorIdentity` {name,email,provider?,providerId?,metadata?}.
- `specIds` mutable (empty OK); workspace validated at create. `workspaces` computed via `parseSpecId()` — plural touched set, NOT primary/home workspace (no `workspaces[0]` for templates/archive). `specDependsOn` optional map; not approval-invalidating; pruned on `updateSpecIds()`. Spec list edits DO invalidate approvals.
- Lifecycle: drafting→designing→ready→[pending-spec-approval→spec-approved]→implementing⇄verifying→done→[pending-signoff→signed-off]→archivable→archiving. Gates from `approvals.spec`/`signoff` (default false). `designing→designing` no invalidate/downgrade. From `archiving` only →`archivable` or →`designing`.
- implementing→verifying gated by task completion; verifying→implementing = implementation-failure only; artifact-review-required → designing.
- Implementation tracking + historical guard: ever `transitioned` to `implementing` → draft/discard fail by default (need force).
- Spec approval / signoff gates when enabled. Schema name mismatch → `SchemaMismatchError`; version mismatch = warning only.
- Artifacts: `ChangeArtifact` {type,optional,requires,state,files:Map}. File states: missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review. Aggregate from files. `skipped` only optional. `markComplete`/`markSkipped` only ValidateArtifacts/skip UC. Return to designing → pending-review (keep drifted). Only complete|skipped satisfy requires.
- `syncArtifacts(artifactTypes)` reconciles map; appends `artifacts-synced` with `SYSTEM_ACTOR`.
- Append-only history; state = last `transitioned.to` (else drafting). Events: created, transitioned, spec-approved, signed-off, invalidated (causes: spec-change|artifact-drift|artifact-review-required|spec-overlap-conflict), drafted, restored, artifact-skipped, artifacts-synced, description-updated, discarded, archive-failed.
- Draft/restore/discard storage moves; drafted = read-only except Restore/Discard via `mutateDraft`.
- LifecycleEngine interprets schema/workflow/gates; Change owns persisted facts only.
- `invalidate()`: cause, message, affectedArtifacts, optional policy override, required `artifactDag`. Policies none|surgical|downstream|global. Always → designing if was elsewhere. `hasDrift` set only for artifact-drift focused files.

## Constraints
- name/createdAt immutable; workspaces derived not persisted; no singular primary workspace.
- State from history only; scope/artifact mods append invalidated + transition designing (except designing→designing).
- validatedHash = last validated baseline only; hasDrift persisted per file.
- skipped optional-only; satisfies requires.
- Policy-driven reopen on invalidate; verifying→implementing resets only implementing.requires.
- Archive only from archivable.
- History never modified/deleted; draft/discard after implementing needs force; discard irreversible + mandatory reason/by.
